# Summary Stastistics

```{r}
# Create a new dataframe with daily average returns per sector
daily_avg_sector_returns <- data_sector_market %>%
  group_by(date, gic_sectors) %>%
  summarise(avg_r_cc = sum(r_cc*Market_Cap) / sum(Market_Cap), 
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = gic_sectors, values_from = avg_r_cc, names_prefix = "sector_")

daily_avg_sector_returns$date = as.Date(daily_avg_sector_returns$date)
```

```{r}
combined_stat_data <- data_sector_market %>%
  dplyr::select(date, spy_r_cc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(daily_avg_sector_returns, by = "date")

combined_stat_data[, -1] = 100*combined_stat_data[, -1] 

# Define the custom statistics function
calculate_stats <- function(data) {
  sapply(data, function(x) c(
    Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Std_Dev = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Kurtosis = kurtosis(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Skewness = skewness(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}

# Apply the function to the combined data excluding the date column
stats_summary <- calculate_stats(combined_stat_data[-1])

stats_summary = round(stats_summary, 3)

stats_df <- as.data.frame(t(stats_summary), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

print(stats_df)
```
Market Cap Distribution

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

setDT(data_sector_market)

# Calculate total market capitalization for each date
total_cap_by_date <- data_sector_market[, .(Total_Cap = sum(Market_Cap, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(date)]

sector_cap_by_date <- data_sector_market[, .(Sector_Cap = sum(Market_Cap, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(date, gic_sectors)]

merged_data <- merge(total_cap_by_date, sector_cap_by_date, by = "date")

# Calculate the proportion of each sector's capitalization to the total
merged_data[, Sector_Proportion := Sector_Cap / Total_Cap]

# Plot the data

  geom_area(aes(y = Total_Cap * Sector_Proportion, fill = gic_sectors), position = "stack") +

  ) +
```

# Compute Quadrant Statistics

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

data_sector_market <- as.data.table(data_sector_market %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date)))


N.cc <- 30
TT.cc <- length(unique(data_sector_market$date))

# Compute the sign of daily returns for each ticker and date, as well as for SPY
data_sector_market[, r_sign := sign(r_cc)]
data_sector_market[, spy_r_sign := sign(spy_r_cc)]

dates.c <- unique(data_sector_market$date)[1:TT.cc]
data_sector_market <- data_sector_market[date %in% dates.c]
# Create a list to store results
results_list.cc_spy <- list()

# Unique sectors
unique_sectors <- unique(data_sector_market$gic_sectors)

# Loop through each sector
for(sector in unique_sectors) {
  
tickers <- data_sector_market[gic_sectors == sector, unique(ticker)]
dt_temp <- data_sector_market[ticker %in% tickers & gic_sectors == sector, .(ticker, date, r_sign, spy_r_sign)]
res <- dt_temp[, .(C.cc_t = sum(r_sign == spy_r_sign & r_sign != 0 & spy_r_sign != 0),
D.cc_t = sum(r_sign != spy_r_sign & r_sign != 0 & spy_r_sign != 0),
Z.cc_t = sum(r_sign == 0 | spy_r_sign == 0),
n.cc.t = N.cc),
by = date]
# Store results in the list, indexed by the sector
results_list.cc_spy[[sector]] <- res
}

results_list.cc_spy <- lapply(results_list.cc_spy, function(x) {
x[, tau.cc_spy_t := (C.cc_t - D.cc_t) / (n.cc.t)]
return(x)
})

results_list.cc_spy <- lapply(results_list.cc_spy, function(x) {
x[, q.cc_spy_t := {
q <- (C.cc_t) / (n.cc.t)

q[q == 0] <- 0.00000001
q[q == 1] <- 0.99999999
q
}]
return(x)
})
```

# Average correlation in the market

Combine sector-wise data

```{r}
combined_data <- rbindlist(results_list.cc_spy, idcol = "id")

combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  rename(gic_sectors = id)

daily_avg_corr_market <- combined_data %>%
group_by(date) %>%
summarise(tau_avg = mean(tau.cc_spy_t, na.rm = TRUE),
          q_avg = mean(q.cc_spy_t, na.rm = TRUE),
          C_sum = sum(C.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
          D_sum = sum(D.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
          n_sum = sum(n.cc.t, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
rename(tau.cc_t = tau_avg, 
       q.cc_t = q_avg, 
       C.cc_t = C_sum, 
       D.cc_t = D_sum,  
       n.cc.t = n_sum) %>%
dplyr::select(date, tau.cc_t, q.cc_t, C.cc_t, D.cc_t, n.cc.t)

# Convert back to data.table
setDT(daily_avg_corr_market)
```

Aggregate by Month and Quarter

```{r}
# Group by year-month
data_grouped <- daily_avg_corr_market %>%
mutate(year_month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
group_by(year_month)

monthly_averages <- data_grouped %>%
summarise(tau.cc_t_avg = mean(tau.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
          q_avg = mean(q.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
          C_sum = sum(C.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
          D_sum = sum(D.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
          n_sum = sum(n.cc.t, na.rm = TRUE))

monthly_averages$year_month = format(monthly_averages$year_month, "%Y-%m")

market_tau_monthly <- rename(monthly_averages, 
                             year_month = year_month, 
                             tau.cc_t = tau.cc_t_avg,
                             q.cc_t = q_avg, 
                             C.cc_t = C_sum, 
                             D.cc_t = D_sum,  
                             n.cc.t = n_sum)

# Remove the first and last month due to incomplete data
market_tau_monthly = market_tau_monthly[2:(nrow(market_tau_monthly)-1), ]

market_tau_monthly$rho.cc_t = sin(pi/2*market_tau_monthly$tau.cc_t)

# Group by year-quarter
data_grouped <- daily_avg_corr_market %>%
  mutate(year_quarter = floor_date(date, "quarter")) %>%
  group_by(year_quarter)

quarterly_averages <- data_grouped %>%
  summarise(tau.cc_t_avg = mean(tau.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
            q_avg = mean(q.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
            C_sum = sum(C.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
            D_sum = sum(D.cc_t, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_sum = sum(n.cc.t, na.rm = TRUE))

market_tau_quarterly <- rename(quarterly_averages, 
                               year_quarter = year_quarter, 
                               tau.cc_t = tau.cc_t_avg,
                               q.cc_t = q_avg, 
                               C.cc_t = C_sum, 
                               D.cc_t = D_sum,  
                               n.cc.t = n_sum)

# Remove the first and last quarters due to incomplete data
market_tau_quarterly = market_tau_quarterly[2:(nrow(market_tau_quarterly)-1), ]

market_tau_quarterly$rho.cc_t = sin(pi/2 * market_tau_quarterly$tau.cc_t)
```

# VAR Analysis

```{r}
fishz = function(x){
0.5 * log((1 + x) / (1 - x))
}

market_tau_monthly$fishz = fishz(market_tau_monthly$tau.cc_t)
market_tau_monthly = market_tau_monthly[, c("year_month", "fishz")]
```

## Import Factors

```{r}
monthly_factor_data <- monthly_factor_data %>%

         year_month = format(date, "%Y-%m"))

monthly_factor_data = monthly_factor_data[, -1]
```

Merge dataset

```{r}
market_tau_monthly$year_month = format(market_tau_monthly$year_month, "%Y-%m")

var_data <- market_tau_monthly %>%
  left_join(monthly_factor_data, by = "year_month")

names(var_data)
```

## Test for stationarity

```{r, eval=FALSE}
adf_test_results <- lapply(var_data[, -1] # exclude year_mon column
                           , function(series) {
  if (is.numeric(series)) { 
    adf_test <- adf.test(series, alternative = "stationary")
    return(list(Statistic = adf_test$statistic, P_Value = adf_test$p.value))
  } else {
    return(NA)  # Non-numeric columns are ignored
  }
})

stationary_variables <- lapply(adf_test_results, function(result) {
  result$P_Value < 0.10
})

cat("Stationary Variables:\n")
print(names(stationary_variables[stationary_variables == TRUE]))

non_stationary_variables <- lapply(adf_test_results, function(result) {
  result$P_Value >= 0.10
})

cat("Non-stationary Variables:\n")
print(names(non_stationary_variables[non_stationary_variables == TRUE]))
```

Take difference on non-stationary variables

```{r}
var_data_diff <- na.omit(var_data)
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
# Determine which columns are numeric (excluding 'year_mon' and 'fishz')
numeric_cols <- sapply(var_data_diff, is.numeric)

# Loop over the columns, applying diff() to each numeric one except 'year_mon'
for (col in names(var_data_diff)[numeric_cols == T]) {
  # Apply diff() and prepend NA to match the length of the original series
  var_data_diff[[col]] <- (var_data_diff[[col]] - lag(var_data_diff[[col]])) #/ lag(var_data_diff[[col]])
}

# Exclude the first row of NA
var_data_diff = var_data_diff[-1, ]

colnames(var_data_diff)

cat("Non-stationary Variables:\n")
print(names(non_stationary_variables[non_stationary_variables == TRUE]))
```

## VAR Estimation

```{r}
VARselect(var_data_diff, lag.max=10, type="const")$selection
```

```{r}
var <- VAR(var_data_diff, p=1, type="const")
summary(var$varresult$fishz)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
stargazer(var$varresult, type = "latex",
          style = "qje",
          summary = FALSE,  
          header = FALSE)
```


```{r, eval=F}
summary_var = summary(var)

corres_matrix = summary_var$corres
covres_matrix = summary_var$covres

stargazer(corres_matrix, type = "latex",
          title = "Correlation and Covariance Matrices",
          summary = FALSE,  
          header = FALSE)   
```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
stargazer(var$varresult, type = "latex", style = "qje")
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
var_irf <- irf(var, n.ahead = 11,ortho = TRUE,boot = TRUE, ci = 0.95, cumulative = F)
```


```{r}
# Extracting the IRF results for 'fishz'
irf_data <- as.data.frame(var_irf$irf$fishz)
colnames(irf_data) <- gsub("fishz.", "", colnames(irf_data))  

# Extracting the confidence intervals
lower_bound <- as.data.frame(var_irf$Lower$fishz)
upper_bound <- as.data.frame(var_irf$Upper$fishz)
colnames(lower_bound) <- gsub("fishz.", "", colnames(lower_bound))
colnames(upper_bound) <- gsub("fishz.", "", colnames(upper_bound))
```

```{r}
# Binding the data together for plotting
irf_data <- irf_data %>% 
  mutate(time = 1:nrow(irf_data)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "impulse", values_to = "response")

lower_bound <- lower_bound %>% 
  mutate(time = 1:nrow(lower_bound)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "impulse", values_to = "lower")

upper_bound <- upper_bound %>% 
  mutate(time = 1:nrow(upper_bound)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "impulse", values_to = "upper")

# Joining all data together
plot_data <- left_join(irf_data, lower_bound, by = c("time", "impulse"))
plot_data <- left_join(plot_data, upper_bound, by = c("time", "impulse"))
```

```{r}
# Plotting with ggplot2 using facets
plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = time, y = response)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(aes(color = impulse), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~impulse, scales = "free_y") + 
  labs(x = "Time Steps", y = "Response of fishz") +  
  theme_linedraw() +  
  theme(legend.position = "none",  
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12)
```

# Unexpected Macro Announcements: Quarterly Analysis

## Score-driven Models

```{r}
log_likelihood_function <- function(params, data){
  # Unpack parameters
  omega <- params[1]
  alpha <- params[2]
  beta <- params[3]
  eta <- params[4] # Initial eta
  
  logL <- 0 # Initialize log-likelihood
  
  for(t in 1:nrow(data)){
    nt <- data$n[t] # n_t
    zt <- data$z[t] # Z_t
    qt <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta)) # q_t
    
    # Log-likelihood for binomial distribution
    ell_t <- zt * log(qt) + (nt - zt) * log(1 - qt)
    logL <- logL + ell_t # Accumulate log-likelihood
    
    # If there is next time point, update eta
    if(t < nrow(data)){
      tilde_st <- (data$hat_q[t] - qt) / (qt * (1 - qt)) # normalized score
      eta <- omega + beta * eta + alpha * tilde_st # Update eta according to model dynamics
    }
  }
  
  return(-logL/(77)) 
}

gradient_function <- function(params, data) {
  # Unpack parameters
  omega <- params[1]
  alpha <- params[2]
  beta <- params[3]
  eta <- params[4] # Initial eta
  
  # Initialize gradient
  gradient <- numeric(length(params))
  
  for(t in 1:nrow(data)) {
    nt <- data$n[t] # n_t
    zt <- data$z[t] # Z_t
    qt <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta)) # q_t
    Delta <- (1/nt) * ((zt - nt) * (qt / (1 - qt)) - zt * ((1 - qt) / qt))
    st <- (data$hat_q[t] - qt)
    tilde_st <- (data$hat_q[t] - qt) / (qt * (1 - qt)) # normalized score
    
    if(t == 1) {
      partial_eta <- c(1, 0, 0, 1)
    } else {
      # Calculate the partial derivatives of eta_t with respect to the parameters
      partial_st_minus_1 <- Delta * partial_eta
      partial_eta <- c(1 + alpha * partial_st_minus_1[1] + beta * partial_eta[1], 
                       tilde_st + alpha * partial_st_minus_1[2] + beta * partial_eta[2], 
                       partial_st_minus_1[3] + eta + beta * partial_eta[3], 
                       alpha * partial_st_minus_1[4] + beta * partial_eta[4])
    }
    
    # Update gradient
    gradient <- gradient + (st * partial_eta)
    
    # If there is next time point, update eta
    if(t < nrow(data)) {
      eta <- omega + beta * eta + alpha * tilde_st # Update eta according to model dynamics
    }
  }
  
  return(-gradient) # Return negative gradient as we are maximizing log-likelihood
}
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(parallel)

# Convert daily_avg_corr_market to a data.table if it's not already one
setDT(market_tau_quarterly)

initial_params <- c(0, 0, 0, 0)

result <- optim(
  par = initial_params,
  fn = log_likelihood_function, 
  data = market_tau_quarterly[, .(z = C.cc_t, n = n.cc.t, hat_q = q.cc_t)],
  method = "BFGS",
  hessian = TRUE
)

se_values <- sqrt(diag(solve(result$hessian)))

# Create the output data.table
results_df_gbnores.cc <- data.table(
  Omega = result$par[1],
  Alpha = result$par[2],
  Beta = result$par[3],
  Eta1 = result$par[4],
  Value = result$value,
  SE_Omega = se_values[1],
  SE_Alpha = se_values[2],
  SE_Beta = se_values[3],
  SE_Eta1 = se_values[4]
)

# Print the results data table
print(results_df_gbnores.cc)
```

```{r}
# Define the function to calculate eta_t
calculate_eta_t <- function(omega, alpha, z_t_minus_1, n_t_minus_1, q_t_minus_1, beta, eta_t_minus_1) {
  omega + alpha * (z_t_minus_1 - n_t_minus_1 * q_t_minus_1) / (n_t_minus_1 * q_t_minus_1 * (1 - q_t_minus_1)) + beta * eta_t_minus_1
}

# Function to process the data
process_data <- function(data, params) {
  # Initialize eta_scobino and q
  data[, eta_scobino := NA_real_]
  data[1, eta_scobino := params$eta1]
  data[, q := NA_real_]
  data[1, q := 1/(1+exp(-params$eta1))]

  # Loop over rows to calculate eta_t and q_t
  for (t in 2:nrow(data)) {
    z_t_minus_1 <- data[t - 1, get("C.cc_t")] 
    n_t_minus_1 <- data[t - 1, get("n.cc.t")] 
    q_t_minus_1 <- data[t - 1, q]
    eta_t_minus_1 <- data[t - 1, eta_scobino]

    # Calculate eta_t
    eta_t <- calculate_eta_t(params$omega, params$alpha, z_t_minus_1, n_t_minus_1, q_t_minus_1, params$beta, eta_t_minus_1)
    
    # Store eta_t and calculate q_t
    data[t, eta_scobino := eta_t]
    data[t, q := 1/(1+exp(-eta_t))]
    
    # Calculate tau_t from estimated q_t
    data[t, tau.cc_model := 2 * q - 1]
  }
  
  return(data)
}

params <- results_df_gbnores.cc[, .(omega = Omega, alpha = Alpha, beta = Beta, eta1 = Eta1)]

# Calculate Fitted Eta
market_tau_quarterly <- process_data(market_tau_quarterly, params)

market_tau_quarterly$year_quarter = paste(format(market_tau_quarterly$year_quarter, "%Y"), 
                                        "/Q", 
                                        lubridate::quarter(market_tau_quarterly$year_quarter), 
                                        sep = "")
```

# (By Sector) Unexpected Macro Announcements: Quarterly Analysis

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(parallel)

setDT(sector_quarterly_avg)

# Define initial parameters
initial_params <- c(0, 0, 0, 0)

sectors <- unique(sector_quarterly_avg$gic_sectors)

# Set up parallel computing
num_cores <- detectCores()
cl <- makeCluster(num_cores)
clusterExport(cl, list("sector_quarterly_avg", "initial_params", "log_likelihood_function"))
clusterEvalQ(cl, library(data.table))

# Function to apply optimization per sector
optimize_sector <- function(sector) {
  data <- sector_quarterly_avg[gic_sectors == sector, .(z = C.cc_t, n = n.cc.t, hat_q = q.cc_t)]
  result <- optim(
    par = initial_params,
    fn = log_likelihood_function,
    data = data,
    method = "BFGS",
    hessian = TRUE
  )
  
  se_values <- sqrt(diag(solve(result$hessian)))  # Calculate standard errors
  
  return(list(
    Sector = sector,
    Omega = result$par[1],
    Alpha = result$par[2],
    Beta = result$par[3],
    Eta1 = result$par[4],
    Value = result$value,
    SE_Omega = se_values[1],
    SE_Alpha = se_values[2],
    SE_Beta = se_values[3],
    SE_Eta1 = se_values[4]
  ))
}

# Run optimization in parallel
results_list <- parLapply(cl, sectors, optimize_sector)
stopCluster(cl)

results_df_gbnores_sector.cc <- rbindlist(results_list)

# Print the results data table
print(results_df_gbnores_sector.cc)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

setDT(sector_quarterly_avg)
setDT(results_df_gbnores_sector.cc)

# Loop over each sector
for(sector in unique(sector_quarterly_avg$gic_sectors)) {
  
  params <- results_df_gbnores_sector.cc[Sector == sector, .(omega = Omega, alpha = Alpha, beta = Beta, eta1 = Eta1)]
  
  sector_data <- sector_quarterly_avg[gic_sectors == sector]
  
  processed_data <- process_data(sector_data, params)
  
  if (!exists("fitted_data")) {
    fitted_data <- processed_data
  } else {
    fitted_data <- rbind(fitted_data, processed_data)
  }
}

sector_quarterly_avg = fitted_data
```
